infoLinks.urlText: Cabramatta bus diversions for Moon Festival
infoLinks.content:
From 12.01am to 11.59pm on Sunday 20 September, Route 805 buses will be diverting around a section of Railway Parade and missing stops due to road closures for the Cabramatta Moon Festival event. 
 
Services will start and end their trips at a temporary bus stop on Railway Parade between McBurney Road and Hughes Street.

Services travelling to Cabramatta will be diverting via Park Road and Hughes Street to the temporary stop on Railway Parade. Services travelling from Cabramatta will start trips from the temporary stop on Railway Parade then travel via its normal route. 

Check signs at stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Visit the Cabramatta Moon Festival event page for more details. 
 
Missed and alternative stops
  • Arthur West Cabramatta Community Hall, McBurney Rd (216669)
    – Alternative stop is a temporary stop on Railway Parade at McBurney Rd (2166263) 
  • Cabramatta Station, Railway Pde, Stand E (216671)
    – Alternative stop is a temporary stop on Railway Parade at McBurney Rd (2166263) 
  • Cabramatta Station, Railway Pde, Stand A (2166249)
    – Alternative stop is a temporary stop on Railway Parade at McBurney Rd (2166263)

infoLinks.urlText: Cabramatta bus diversions for Moon Festival
infoLinks.content:
From 12.01am to 11.59pm on Sunday 20 September, Route 817 buses will divert around a section of Railway Parade and missing stops due to road closures for the Cabramatta Moon Festival event. 
 
Services will start and end their trips at a temporary bus stop on Railway Parade between McBurney Road and Hughes Street.

Services travelling to Cabramatta will divert via McBurney Road, Park Road and Hughes Street to the temporary stop on Railway Parade. Services travelling from Cabramatta will start trips from the temporary stop on Railway Parade then travel via its normal route.
 
Check signs at stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Visit the Cabramatta Moon Festival event page for more details. 
 
Missed stops
  • Cabramatta Station, Railway Parade, Stand E (216671) 
  • Cabramatta Station, Railway Parade, Stand A (2166249)
– Alternative stop for both stops is a temporary stop on Railway Parade at McBurney Road (2166263)
